profile.headline: Senior Web Developer at ADT
profile.summary: Web Developer with experience in developing user interfaces using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, VueJS ReactJS, Bootstrap and MVC Architecture. Strong team player with excellent learning and problem solving ability.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Develop components using Vue 3, SCSS, NodeJS, REST API along with dependencies (Axios, Vuex, Vue Router, Vuelidate)
•	Code, maintain, and support the applications
•	Program, test, and implement mapped graphic images, forms, and HTML pages
•	Create services that communicate with the Cloud via Push/REST
•	Develop responsive UI components and content modules
•	Write scalable, testable, and maintainable code

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developing and maintaining the applications for the organization’s Organic, Paid Media and Partner sites (ADT.com, ADT.com/Media and several others) for all devices.
•	Upgrading existing components from Classic UI to Touch UI for AEM 6.3.
•	Managing and testing code sync in all environments 
•	Programming the selected components of web applications using AEM and HTL.
•	Writing, designing, and editing web page and its content.
•	Develop web sites using authoring language, content creation tools, management tools, and digital media.
•	Evaluate code to ensure its correctness and make it compatible with required browsers and devices.
•	Validate test routines and schedules to ensure those functionalities are working correctly with external interfaces and support in different browsers.
•	Communicate with UX designers and business personnel for layouts, develop strategies and plans to develop the website and to integrate these strategies with web sites.
•	Involved in reskin of adt.com

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed “Activity Tracker” application using Google AppMaker for syncing Google Calendar Meetings, adding meeting notes and assign tasks.
•	Developed charts using Google Charts, JSCharts and yellowfins.
•	Maintained documents for changes in existing application in word and excel files.
•	Develop web sites, using scripting languages and frameworks and digital media.
•	Writing, designing, and editing web page and its content.
•	Identify problems uncovered by performing unit testing and resolve problems.
•	Used best practices to write code and continuously read about the new web technologies and best practices.
•	Analyze user needs to determine technical requirements.
•	Perform website tests according to planned schedules, or after any web site or product revisions.
•	Develop and document style guidelines for code reusability and better user experience.
•	Handled entire app development process from designing to deployment.
•	Provide clear, detailed descriptions of website specifications, functionalities, and features.
•	Communicate with UX designers and business personnel for layouts, develop strategies and plans to develop the website and to integrate these strategies with web sites.
•	Identify or maintain page navigation and ensure proper functioning.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed single page web application using HTML5, CSS3, SCSS, CSS frameworks (Bootstrap, Atomic) and JavaScript frameworks (AngularJs, MarionetteJS, ReactJS) for all screen sizes that followed WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines.
•	Integrate JavaScript plugins in webpage or website.
•	Tested front-end code using developer tools in different web browsers to ensure cross-browser compatibility.
•	Worked in Agile environment and assured on-time delivery.
•	Taking responsibilities to help team members and contributed to find solutions.
•	Communicated with clients for further changes.
•	Responsible for building prototypes of using HTML5 and CSS3.
•	Communicated with UX designer for better and rich User experience.
•	Handled PgAdminII and MySQL database, connection to RESTful API and functionalities of web pages.
•	Used Jira, Tortoise Git and Tortoise SVN on daily basis to manage and maintain code.
•	Recommend and implement web optimization techniques for performance improvements.
•	Automate tasks which are repetitive using Gulp.
•	Identify or maintain page navigation and ensure proper functioning.
•	Develop and document style guidelines for code reusability and better user experience
•	Perform website tests according to planned schedules, or after any web site or product revisions.
•	Communicate with UX designers and business personnel for layouts, develop strategies and plans to develop the website and to integrate these strategies with web sites.
•	Develop and maintain databases using MySQL and pgAdminII.
•	Develop web sites, using scripting languages and frameworks and digital media.
•	Initiate standup meetings and discuss and resolve the conflicts and prioritize needs.
•	Evaluate code to ensure its correctness and make it compatible with required browsers and devices.
•	Used best practices to write code and continuously read about the new web technologies and best practices. 
•	Demonstrated ability to work under pressure to meet deadline.

educations.schoolName: K. J. Somaiya Institute of Technology

honors.title: Capstone Winner
honors.description: Awarded first place for outstanding performance in the university capstone project. Collaborated with a team to deliver an innovative solution aligned with Mapfre's objectives, leveraging system design and project management. Recognized for excellence in problem-solving, teamwork, and delivering tangible results that addressed real-world business challenges.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Gave presentations on PC Assembling, Photoshop, VM ware, Android and many other technologies.
Organized clean-up drive at beach and TB awareness campaign.

publications.title: Android Based Video Enhancement
publications.publisher: International Journal of Research in Advent Technology · Mar 1, 2015
